performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

body:
> [!CAUTION]
> **Risk: high.** Adds a telemetry event (`editor_speed_changed` in the shared `src/shared/analytics.ts`, data leaving the app) and rewrites the central playback clock in `use-preview-playback.ts`, which every editing action and every clip/slide hand-off goes through (the PR now changes how every clip plays, not only the speed). Read from `git diff origin/feature/niw2-665-tracks-popover...HEAD` by the verifier.

### Review ledger — 3 reviewer rounds plus one different-provider round (budget: 5 for high risk)

Models: round 1 Opus 5.5 and, in parallel, Codex gpt-6.1-sol (high) · round 2 Opus 5.5 · round 3 Opus 5.5. Fixes were written by separate Sonnet 5.5 sessions.

| id | severity | finding | outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 (Codex) / S1 (Opus) | blocker / should | a clip's end was only detected in `onVideoTimeUpdate` (~250 ms): at speed a slide between clips is skipped or deleted footage plays; same logic on `main` | fixed 0c88e06d (per-frame rAF hand-off, `timeupdate` kept as fallback); resolved r2 |
| S2 | nit | export isolation scan read only the top level with a regex | fixed 016bbff2 (recursive, TS syntax tree) |
| S3 | nit | self-comparing assertions that cannot fail | fixed b783501b |
| S4 | nit | Spanish showed "1.5×" | fixed 93a721ab (`formatSpeed`, locale-aware: "1,5×") |
| S5 | nit | the new value is only in the focused button's aria-label (VoiceOver may not announce it) | declined: unverified, no `aria-live` added blind; follow-up |
| R2-1 | should (regression of 0c88e06d) | the hand-off sought at every source-contiguous split (audio drop-out risk on an unedited split) | fixed d222c3b6 (no seek for contiguous clips); resolved r3 |
| R2-2 | should (regression of 0c88e06d) | the last clip ending at the file end paused before native `ended`; play then flickered | fixed e2ebac2d (`play()` at the end restarts from 0); resolved r3 |
| R2-3 | nit | `onVideoEnded` had no slide guard | fixed 514e8130 |
| R2-4 | nit | no tests that edit the layout while playing | fixed 6d2bf6ad (split, trim, delete while playing) |
| R2-5 | nit | the isolation scan's bare `rate`/`speed` identifiers can false-positive | declined; the failure names file and identifier |
| R3-1 | nit | `seek()` does not update `lastValidTimeRef`: a backward seek landing in the 20 ms pre-cut window can jump the playhead forward for one frame | declined; follow-up (set it in `seek()` and the gap snap, plus one test) |
| R3-2 | nit | the contiguous shortcut does not check that the element already passed `next.sourceEnd` (timeupdate-only path, very short second half) | declined; follow-up |
| R3-3 | nit, unverified | a `sourceEnd` more than 20 ms past the media's real end never hands off; only `ended` fires (same on `main`) | declined; follow-up |

**Verdict for 6d2bf6ad (patch-id 46473f68c5e8): approved, only nits remain.** Merge order: #540 → #541 → #542 → this PR, each retargeted to `main` as the one below merges. Not verified: any real playback in the app (a split, a slide between clips, play to the end then play again, 1x and 2x, audio and pitch at 0.5x/2x); a real MP4 exported at 2x; the event reaching PostHog; the Spanish screenshots in the PR predate F4 and still show "1.5×". An approved verdict is not permission to merge.
